text: Exterminate all Titans and avenge his mother.
fear: Dying powerless behind the walls.
belief: Titans are monstrous invaders that must be eradicated.
secret: Harbors dormant Titan power transferred by his father
spoiler_notes: Possesses the Attack Titan unbeknownst to himself; swallowed in Trost

text: Master his Titan powers, seal Wall Maria, and reach the basement.
fear: Losing control of his Titan and endangering trusted comrades.
belief: Trusting comrades and the Scout Regiment leads to victory.
secret: Possesses the Coordinate power triggered through royal contact
spoiler_notes: Defeats Female Titan in Stohess; unlocks Founding Titan power against Smiling Titan

text: Reclaim Wall Maria and discover the secrets of the outside world.
fear: His father's sins make his own existence a mistake.
belief: He is not inherently special, but humanity must be liberated.
secret: Grisha stole the Founder by consuming the royal Reiss family
spoiler_notes: Unlocks hardening ability; retakes Shiganshina; reaches the ocean

text: Preemptively strike Marley and secure the Founding Titan's full power.
fear: Paradis being obliterated by the allied global fleet.
belief: Freedom must be seized by force through relentless forward momentum.
secret: Feigns cooperation with Zeke while secretly pursuing full Rumbling
spoiler_notes: Disguised as wounded soldier Kruger; attacks Liberio; consumes War Hammer Titan

text: Eradicate humanity outside the walls to protect Paradis and his friends.
fear: Failing to end the Titan curse and free his friends.
belief: He was born into this world free and will take the freedom of those who oppose him.
secret: Influenced past Attack Titan inheritors via future Paths memories
spoiler_notes: Frees Ymir; unleashes Wall Titans; defeated and slain by Mikasa

text: Survive the Titan threat and see the outside world and the sea.
fear: Being a useless burden to Eren and Mikasa.
belief: The outside world contains wonders beyond the walls.
secret: Harbors deep feelings of cowardice and physical inadequacy
spoiler_notes: Devises the tactical recovery plan for the Trost supply depot

text: Protect his companions and outwit enemy Titan shifters.
fear: Hesitation leading to the death of his comrades.
belief: To overcome monsters one must be willing to abandon humanity.
secret: Deduces the true identities of Annie, Reiner, and Bertholdt
spoiler_notes: Exposes Annie Leonhart as the Female Titan in Stohess

text: Defeat the Colossal Titan, reach the basement, and see the ocean.
fear: Failing to live up to the sacrifices of Erwin Smith and his fallen comrades.
belief: Sacrificing one's life can create the sole path to victory.
secret: Revived using the Titan injection instead of Erwin Smith
spoiler_notes: Sacrifices himself to defeat Bertholdt; inherits the Colossal Titan

text: Find peaceful diplomatic alternatives to avoid global devastation.
fear: Eren's escalating extremism ruining chances of mutual peace.
belief: Dialogue and mutual understanding remain viable through patience.
secret: Regularly confides his inner turmoil to the crystallized Annie
spoiler_notes: Annihilates the Liberio navy; horrified by civilian casualties

text: Halt the Rumbling and save humanity beyond the walls.
fear: Having to kill his best friend Eren to stop the genocide.
belief: Life gains true meaning through small everyday moments of connection.
secret: Named 15th Commander of the Survey Corps by Hange Zoe
spoiler_notes: Convinces Zeke in the Paths; transforms to battle Eren's Colossal form

text: Protect Eren from danger and stay by Eren's side.
fear: Losing Eren and being left isolated in a brutal world.
belief: The world is cruel, but it is also very beautiful.
secret: Awakened dormant superhuman combat reflexes during childhood trauma
spoiler_notes: Graduates top of 104th; inspires cadets to fight after Eren's fall

text: Defend Eren against hostile Titan shifters and military trials.
fear: Failing to rescue Eren from abduction.
belief: As long as she has Eren, she has a home.
secret: Ackerman bloodline grants innate battle experience of past ancestors
spoiler_notes: Incapacitates Female Titan; nearly killed during Eren's rescue from Reiner

text: Reclaim Wall Maria and protect both Eren and Armin from death.
fear: Having to choose between saving Armin or Erwin.
belief: Those who cannot abandon anything cannot change anything.
secret: Carries the royal crest of the Azumabito clan tattooed on her wrist
spoiler_notes: Attacks Levi during the serum dispute; reaches the sea with the scouts

text: Understand Eren's sudden coldness and bring Eren back home.
fear: Eren's claim that her devotion is merely inherited servitude.
belief: Eren is still the caring person who wrapped the scarf around her.
secret: Deeply distressed by Eren stating he has always hated her
spoiler_notes: Rescues Eren in Liberio; removes her scarf after Eren's verbal assault

text: Stop the Rumbling while carrying her enduring love for Eren.
fear: Allowing Eren to massacre the rest of the world.
belief: Her love and devotion were genuine choices born of free will.
secret: Decides to personally execute Eren while wearing his red scarf
spoiler_notes: Kills Eren inside the Founder; frees founder Ymir from Fritz's curse

text: Serve as a dependable big brother and vanguard soldier in the 104th Cadet Corps.
fear: Failing his hidden duty and losing the trust of the comrades around him.
belief: A true soldier must shoulder every hardship to protect those beside him.
secret: Broke Wall Maria as the Armored Titan in 845
spoiler_notes: Acts as trustworthy big brother to 104th; leaks scout positions to Annie

text: Survive the Titan siege in the interior while wrestling with his hidden mission.
fear: Mental breakdown from crushing guilt over the comrades he has betrayed.
belief: He cannot reconcile his identity as a Wall soldier with his true mission.
secret: Suffers from split-personality psychosis blurring friend and foe
spoiler_notes: Casually confesses identity on Wall Rose; transforms into Armored Titan

text: Ambush the Survey Corps and capture Eren at Shiganshina.
fear: Dying before fulfilling his promise to protect his Warrior comrades.
belief: The soldiers inside the walls possess terrifying weapons that threaten his homeland.
secret: Marcel deliberately sabotaged Porco to ensure Reiner got the Armored Titan
spoiler_notes: Blown apart by Thunder Spears; barely survives decapitation; loses Bertholdt

text: Protect the young Warrior candidates from inheriting the Armored Titan curse.
fear: His younger cousin suffering the same trauma he endured.
belief: He is a wretched sinner who deserves to die for his crimes.
secret: Attempted suicide with a rifle in Liberio until stopped by Falco's voice
spoiler_notes: Begs Eren to kill him in Liberio basement; rallies Marley to counterattack Paradis

text: Stop the Rumbling alongside the joint Paradis-Marley alliance.
fear: The extermination of Liberio and the death of his mother Karina.
belief: People on both sides of the sea are fundamentally the same.
secret: Openly confesses to Jean that he forced the mission after Marcel died
spoiler_notes: Battles Hallucigenia and past Titan shifters on the Founding Titan's spine

text: Test wall defenses and inspect vertical maneuvering equipment.
fear: Marley discovering his secret royal Fritz lineage.
belief: Eldians within the walls are hopelessly ignorant primitives.
secret: Can turn subjects of Ymir into Titans with spinal fluid and vocal commands
spoiler_notes: Transforms Ragako village; interrogates and kills Section Commander Miche

text: Wipe out the Survey Corps and recover the Founding Titan from Eren.
fear: Levi Ackerman's monstrous close-quarters combat skill.
belief: Dying without being born is the greatest salvation for Eldians.
secret: Is Grisha Yeager's firstborn son and Eren's older half-brother
spoiler_notes: Massacres Erwin's suicide charge with pitching strikes; dismembered by Levi

text: Euthanize all Eldians by altering their physiology via the Founder.
fear: Eren rejecting his brotherly affection and the euthanasia plan.
belief: Ending Eldian reproduction will peacefully eradicate Titans from the world.
secret: Spiked Paradis military wine reserves with his own spinal fluid
spoiler_notes: Orchestrates Liberio raid; escapes on airship; blown up by thunder spear

text: Find peace in non-existence and aid the Alliance after realizing life's worth.
fear: That his entire life and suffering were utterly pointless.
belief: Natural reproduction merely perpetuates endless suffering.
secret: Turned in his own restorationist parents to Marley to save himself
spoiler_notes: Outmaneuvered by Eren in Paths; builds sand castles; lets Levi behead him

text: Help others and die a noble death to be remembered fondly.
fear: Being exposed as an illegitimate cursed child that nobody wanted.
belief: A sacrificial death is the only way to validate her unworthy existence.
secret: Krista Lenz is an alias forced on her after her mother's execution
spoiler_notes: Graduates 10th in 104th; joins scouts to follow Ymir; reveals name in ep 37

text: Live proudly for herself and refuse to be her father's sacrificial pawn.
fear: Becoming an empty vessel ruled by the First King's ideology.
belief: Even if humanity is wiped out, she will stand with her true friends.
secret: Rod Reiss planned for her to eat Eren and take the Founder's vow of renunciation
spoiler_notes: Destroys the Titan syringe; frees Eren; rejects divine royal duty

text: Govern the kingdom within the walls with genuine care and provide asylum for orphans and outcasts.
fear: Remaining merely a hollow figurehead puppet of the military assembly.
belief: True royalty serves the vulnerable rather than lording over them.
secret: Channels royal treasury to build farm shelters across the underground and districts
spoiler_notes: Lands the killing strike on Rod Reiss's Titan; officially crowned monarch

text: Protect Paradis and avert the 50-year plan that would force her to breed Titans.
fear: Her future children being subjected to continuous Titan inheritance rituals.
belief: The cycle of parents sacrificing their children for the state must be broken.
secret: Concurred with Eren's preemptive warning and chose pregnancy to delay titanization
spoiler_notes: Gives birth during the Rumbling; presides as head of state in post-war Paradis

text: Inherit the Armored Titan to prove Liberio Eldians are honorable citizens.
fear: Her family and community being condemned due to the sins of island devils.
belief: Island Eldians are evil devils who abandoned their continental brethren.
secret: Stowed away with Falco aboard the retreating Scout Regiment airship.
spoiler_notes: Shoots and kills Sasha Blouse aboard the airship after the Liberio raid.

text: Escape captivity and expose the wickedness of the island devils.
fear: Realizing that the islanders are ordinary people without malice.
belief: Island Eldians deserve retribution for ancestral crimes against humanity.
secret: Posing as an orphaned refugee named Mia while sheltered by Sasha's family.
spoiler_notes: Discovers Sasha's family harbors no hatred; decapitates Eren with an anti-Titan rifle.

text: Stop the Rumbling and protect Falco and innocent lives across the world.
fear: The total annihilation of Liberio and her family by the Wall Titans.
belief: There were never any devils; everyone was blinded by hatred and ignorance.
secret: Allied with Scout veterans to overthrow Yeagerist military control.
spoiler_notes: Saves Kaya from a Titan and helps the Alliance fight on the Founding Titan.

text: Inherit the Armored Titan to spare Gabi from a shortened lifespan.
fear: Gabi dying young or his family facing purge for past Restorationist ties.
belief: War is horrifying and Eldians are trapped in an unfair cycle of suffering.
secret: Carried secret letters for wounded soldier Kruger, who was Eren Jaeger.
spoiler_notes: Unwittingly aids Eren in coordinating the surprise assault on Liberio.

text: Protect Gabi from harm and de-escalate hostility with the islanders.
fear: Transforming into a Pure Titan after ingesting tainted spinal fluid.
belief: People on Paradis are ordinary humans caught in tragic circumstances.
secret: Concealing that he consumed wine contaminated with Zeke's spinal fluid.
spoiler_notes: Confesses love to Gabi; turns into a Titan and devours Porco to inherit the Jaw Titan.

text: Master his flight ability to rescue the Alliance and halt the Rumbling.
fear: Losing control of his Titan and failing to reach the battlefield in time.
belief: Empathy and global cooperation are the only hope to break the cycle of hatred.
secret: Accessed Beast Titan memories allowing his Jaw Titan to manifest wings.
spoiler_notes: Manifests a winged titan form and flies the Alliance to the Battle of Heaven and Earth.

text: Provide reconnaissance and logistical support for Zeke and the Warrior Unit.
fear: Losing the Beast and Armored Titans to the Survey Corps.
belief: Faithfully serving Marley guarantees medical care and safety for her sick father.
secret: Identity and tactical intelligence of the quadrupedal Cart Titan.
spoiler_notes: Transports supplies for Zeke and rescues Zeke and Reiner from the Scouts.

text: Protect her fellow Warriors and secure civil rights for continental Eldians.
fear: Eldians being exterminated once anti-Titan military technology renders them obsolete.
belief: True loyalty belongs to her fellow Eldian comrades, not the Marleyan state.
secret: Infiltrated Paradis military police in disguise to track Eren Jaeger.
spoiler_notes: Tricks Eren onto Shiganshina's roof to signal Marley's surprise counter-invasion.

text: Neutralize Eren to stop the Rumbling, save her father, and preserve humanity.
fear: The global extermination of all life outside Paradis by the Wall Titans.
belief: National grudges must be abandoned to confront existential annihilation.
secret: Rigged the Founding Titan's nape with explosives to decapitate Eren.
spoiler_notes: Executes dozens of consecutive transformations fighting shifters on the Founding Titan.

text: Prove his elite Warrior prowess and restore honor to the Galliard family.
fear: Being deemed inferior to Reiner Braun or failing to match his brother Marcel.
belief: Marley's Titans are invincible and island devils must be crushed without mercy.
secret: Harbors intense resentment over Reiner being awarded the Armored Titan.
spoiler_notes: Eren uses Porco's jaws as a nutcracker to crush the Warhammer Titan's crystal.

text: Avenge the Liberio humiliation and defeat the Attack Titan in Shiganshina.
fear: Dying in Reiner's shadow without uncovering the truth behind Marcel's death.
belief: Fighting relentlessly for his comrades is the only honorable path left.
secret: Inherited Marcel's memories revealing Marcel undermined Porco to protect him.
spoiler_notes: Sacrifices himself to be eaten by Pure Titan Falco, saving Reiner and passing on the Jaw Titan.

text: Infiltrate the Military Police in the interior to locate the crown's hidden power.
fear: Failing her mission and never fulfilling her promise to return to her father.
belief: Human nature is fundamentally selfish, making noble ideals absurd.
secret: Wields the Female Titan and assisted in breaching Wall Maria.
spoiler_notes: Infiltrated the 104th Cadet Corps and secured placement in the Military Police.

text: Capture Eren Jaeger and escape back to her homeland to reunite with her father.
fear: Capture, torture, and interrogation by the Scout Regiment.
belief: Personal survival must take precedence over morality or comradeship.
secret: Ability to encase her physical body in an indestructible crystalline shell.
spoiler_notes: Annihilates the Special Operations Squad before encasing herself in crystal in Stohess.

text: Remain in protective stasis until external rescue or release becomes possible.
fear: Enduring eternal, isolated confinement beneath Wall Sina.
belief: Her adoptive father is still alive and awaiting her return.
secret: Remained conscious inside the crystal and heard visits from Armin and Hitch.
spoiler_notes: Released when Eren unhardens all Titan crystal during the start of the Rumbling.

text: Find her father in Marley, later fighting alongside the Alliance to save humanity.
fear: Arriving in Liberio only to discover her father already crushed by the Rumbling.
belief: Senseless violence is exhausting, but protecting loved ones is worth fighting for.
secret: Reciprocated romantic feelings toward Armin Arlert.
spoiler_notes: Assists the Alliance at the harbor and fights on the Founding Titan atop Falco's back.

text: Blend in as an ordinary cadet while awaiting opportunities to locate the royal power.
fear: His identity as the Colossal Titan being exposed to his comrades.
belief: The people inside the walls are dangerous sinners whose annihilation is necessary.
secret: Personally kicked down the outer gate of Shiganshina and breached Trost.
spoiler_notes: Breached Wall Maria in episode 1 and Wall Rose's Trost gate in episode 4.

text: Capture Eren and Ymir to return to his homeland and end his undercover torment.
fear: Confronting the heartbreak and hatred of comrades he genuinely loved.
belief: Neither side is evil; the world is simply too cruel and unforgiving.
secret: Harbors unrequited romantic feelings for Annie Leonhart.
spoiler_notes: Reveals his Colossal Titan identity atop Wall Rose; kidnaps Eren and flees.

text: Annihilate the Scout Regiment in Shiganshina to finish the mission and save Annie.
fear: Failing his duty and dying without accomplishing anything for his homeland or Annie.
belief: He accepts his role as a mass murderer because someone must carry out the tragedy.
secret: Devastating explosive transformation capable of acting as a tactical nuclear blast.
spoiler_notes: Burns Armin Arlert with steam before being defeated and devoured by Armin's Pure Titan.

text: Protect his family in Shiganshina while preparing Eren to inherit the truth.
fear: The royal family's refusal to act causing the destruction of his family.
belief: Humanity inside the walls has a fundamental right to know the truth of the world.
secret: Hidden journals in his basement documenting the true history of humanity.
spoiler_notes: Entrusts Eren with the basement key and injects him with Titan serum before vanishing.

text: Seize the Founding Titan from the royal family to defend the walls from Titans.
fear: The Reiss royal family allowing Titans to exterminate every wall resident.
belief: The royal Vow Renouncing War is an unjust death sentence for innocent subjects.
secret: Devoured Frieda Reiss for the Founder and sacrificed himself to young Eren.
spoiler_notes: Slaughtered Frieda Reiss and her siblings beneath the Reiss Chapel in 845.

text: Overthrow Marleyan rule, avenge his sister Fay, and restore the Eldian nation.
fear: The complete extinction or eternal subjugation of Eldians under Marley.
belief: Eldians are the proud descendants of Ymir, persecuted through fabricated history.
secret: Received the Attack Titan and infiltration mission from Eren Kruger.
spoiler_notes: Basement journals reveal his youth in Liberio, Dina Fritz, Zeke's betrayal, and the Owl.

text: Carry out the Attack Titan's timeline while desperately begging Zeke to stop Eren.
fear: The horrifying, apocalyptic future of the Rumbling that future Eren revealed to him.
belief: He is an unwilling pawn enslaved by future memories sent across time by his son.
secret: Refused to slaughter the Reiss children until future Eren psychically coerced him.
spoiler_notes: Paths memories reveal future Eren coerced Grisha into slaughtering the Reiss family.
